endorsements.quote: Formulating integrated long-term and short-term plans for AI utilization to effectively manage PHC challenges and achieve a desirable future.
Empowering managers and employees with training programs on AI opportunities and application mechanisms in PHC.
Educating the public on the benefits of AI-based care to reduce resistance and improve access to these services.

unlisted_practices: Establish legal frameworks and guidelines to support AI adoption and accessibility in primary health care.
Establish health policy adjustments, including regulatory frameworks and ethics committees, to facilitate AI adaptation in primary health care.
Engage interdisciplinary teams, including ethics, law, and technology expertise, to address AI's multifaceted challenges in primary care.
Build a repository of early case studies of AI in primary health care, documenting barriers and successful implementation practices.
Identify and monitor advancements in AI for integration into the primary health care system.
Develop sustainable financing mechanisms and appropriate payment mechanisms for AI-driven care.
Strengthen information systems to maximize AI opportunities within primary health care.
Promote cultural and social interventions to prepare the public for AI integration in primary health care.
Raise awareness among system stakeholders to prepare them for future technological changes.
Develop robust cybersecurity measures, ethical guidelines, and legal frameworks for responsible AI implementation in primary health care.
Develop a deep understanding of primary health care challenges among policymakers to provide tailored AI solutions.

screen.reason: This is a futures-thinking conceptual framework/policy paper developing governance and strategic scenarios for AI integration into Iran's primary health care system, rather than an empirical evaluation of an AI tool.
